blocks.markdown:
Use the **past simple** for a finished time: *I saw her yesterday.*

Use the **present perfect** when the time is not finished or not named: *I have seen her this week. Have you ever been to Spain?*

Check your answers before you submit: nothing is marked until you do.

blocks.solution_explanation: *Yesterday* is a finished time, so the past simple: *I lost my keys yesterday.*
*Ever* asks about your whole life up to now, an unfinished time: *Have you ever eaten sushi?*
*This week* is not over yet, so the present perfect: *She has written three emails this week.*
